_comment: CERTIFIED per-stage routing manifest (group 0081). This is the version-controlled pin of the tuned routing: the 0076-certified swarm preset (judge/fanout on deepinfra) plus the 0062 L3 jury floor (3 jurors, 10 axes). The live profile files under config/ are gitignored LOCAL state and proved silently mutable between sessions — on 07-04 a drifted pipeline.judge block (openai→copilot) burned a day of copilot credits and derailed the post-hoc audit (TSR 0080.0007). check_routing_drift (hive/config.py) compares every loaded config against this manifest and hive.py warns loudly at run start on any mismatch. Only keys listed here are compared; drift is a WARNING, not a hard stop (deliberate experiments stay possible). Update this file ONLY alongside a new certified preset decision.
